correctness.rationale: The proof explicitly interwines full heat gradients with a two-dimensional positive system plus scalar deviations. All edge rows and their signs are reconstructed; strict dominance follows from the exact three-exponential comparison and positive/Jensen cases. The unique peak and sharp fixed-k envelope follow from exact two-rate eigenvalues and a verified positive polynomial identity. Seven exact-rational intertwining instances, 28 independent full heat-uniformization cases and 90 additional random cases corroborate the algebra; no finite test is presented as an infinite proof.

The exact all-time norm, unique maximizing edge and rigid extremizers reveal meaningful symmetry-breaking under generator perturbations, including near-5/3 amplification on only four vertices.
